changeSet.sql: UPDATE m_loan l SET unearned_interest_foreclosure_derived = GREATEST( COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(lrs.interest_amount) FROM m_loan_repayment_schedule_history lrs WHERE lrs.loan_id = l.id AND lrs.version = ( SELECT MIN(lrs2.version) FROM m_loan_repayment_schedule_history lrs2 WHERE lrs2.loan_id = l.id ) ), 0) - COALESCE(l.interest_repaid_derived, 0) - COALESCE(l.interest_outstanding_derived, 0), 0 ) WHERE l.loan_sub_status_id = 100 AND COALESCE(l.unearned_interest_foreclosure_derived, 0) = 0;
